Water Leakage.title: Inspect leakage
Water Leakage.description: Assess the source and severity of the water leakage.

Water Leakage.title: Isolate/repair pipeline
Water Leakage.description: Shut off water supply if necessary and repair the damaged pipeline.

Water Leakage.title: Verify restoration
Water Leakage.description: Restore water supply and verify no further leakage.

Road Damage.title: Inspect road damage
Road Damage.description: Assess the extent of the potholes or road damage.

Road Damage.title: Repair road surface
Road Damage.description: Fill potholes and resurface the affected road area.

Roadside Flooding.title: Inspect flooded road
Roadside Flooding.description: Assess the flooded area and identify the cause of water accumulation.

Roadside Flooding.title: Clear obstruction
Roadside Flooding.description: Clear any drainage blockages contributing to the flooding.

Roadside Flooding.title: Restore affected road
Roadside Flooding.description: Ensure the road is safe and functional post-flooding.

Drainage.title: Inspect drainage system
Drainage.description: Identify the point of overflow or blockage.

Drainage.title: Clear drainage blockage
Drainage.description: Remove debris or silt causing the overflow.

Drainage.title: Sanitize area
Drainage.description: Clean and sanitize the surrounding area affected by sewage.

Garbage.title: Assess garbage dump
Garbage.description: Evaluate the volume and type of accumulated waste.

Garbage.title: Clear garbage
Garbage.description: Dispatch vehicles to collect and clear the accumulated garbage.

Garbage.title: Clean area
Garbage.description: Clean the area to prevent health hazards and stray animal gathering.

Streetlight.title: Inspect streetlight
Streetlight.description: Identify if the issue is a fused bulb, wiring, or timer.

Streetlight.title: Repair or replace streetlight
Streetlight.description: Fix the wiring or replace the faulty streetlight.

Electric Pole.title: Inspect electrical hazard
Electric Pole.description: Identify exposed wires, sparking, or broken infrastructure.

Electric Pole.title: Secure exposed electrical equipment
Electric Pole.description: Isolate the area to prevent public access and electrocution.

Electric Pole.title: Repair electrical hazard
Electric Pole.description: Fix the underlying electrical issue safely.

Electric Pole.title: Verify safety
Electric Pole.description: Test the equipment to ensure it is completely safe.

Traffic Signal.title: Investigate traffic signal
Traffic Signal.description: Identify the cause of traffic signal malfunction.

Traffic Signal.title: Restore signal operation
Traffic Signal.description: Repair the fault and restore traffic signal operation.

Tree Hazard.title: Resolve safety hazard
Tree Hazard.description: Remove or fix the object/structure causing the hazard.
